description: Reference Tables for TfNSW GTFS feeds is a dataset listed in Transport for NSW Open Data Hub (opendata.transport.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport Open Data Hub. Reference tables for TfNSW data. A complete list of agencies and how they are defined in each GTFS feed. Using Complete GTFS + Real-Time GTFS feeds The reference tables illustrates agencies that appear in multiple GTFS feeds. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher Transport Open Data Hub. Its tags are GTFS guides, diesel, diesel services, frequency services, gtfs r. It offers 13 resource(s) in csv, xlsx. The portal shows 2026-09-14 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tfnsw-open-data-hub.
